description: This file contains implementations of speech recognition models, including Wav2Letter, DeepSpeech, and transformer-based models, with auxiliary classes for sequence processing and attention mechanisms.

classes.name: Wav2Letter
classes.description: Neural network model for speech recognition based on the Wav2Letter architecture.

classes.name: SequenceWise
classes.description: Utility class to apply a module across sequence data by collapsing and restoring dimensions.

classes.name: MaskConv
classes.description: Convolutional module that applies masking based on sequence lengths to handle variable input sizes.

classes.name: InferenceBatchSoftmax
classes.description: Applies softmax during inference, identity during training.

classes.name: BatchRNN
classes.description: Recurrent neural network module with optional batch normalization and bidirectionality.

classes.name: Lookahead
classes.description: Lookahead convolution layer for unidirectional RNNs to incorporate future context.

classes.name: DeepSpeech
classes.description: DeepSpeech speech recognition model combining convolutional, RNN, and fully connected layers.

classes.name: PositionalEncoding
classes.description: Adds positional information to sequence embeddings using sine and cosine functions.

classes.name: TransformerModel
classes.description: Transformer-based sequence model with encoder, positional encoding, and decoder.

classes.name: MultiheadAttentionContainer
classes.description: Container for multi-head attention mechanism combining projection, attention, and output layers.

classes.name: InProjContainer
classes.description: Container for in-projection linear layers for query, key, and value.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines the forward pass for each model or module, processing input tensors.

methods.name: get_seq_lens
methods.description: Calculates output sequence lengths after convolutional layers based on input lengths.

methods.name: init_weights
methods.description: Initializes weights for transformer encoder and decoder.
